questions.question: What does a red X above a motorway lane mean?
options: The lane is closed and you must not drive in it
Speed up to clear the lane
Only buses may use the lane
questions.explanation: A red X closes the lane by law. Move into an open lane early.

questions.question: What should you do when amber lights flash on a motorway signal?
options: Slow down and watch for a hazard ahead
Maintain 70 mph until you see a red light
Pull onto the hard shoulder immediately
questions.explanation: Flashing amber signals warn of a hazard ahead, so reduce your speed.
